title: Google Recommendations AI pricing - Tiered consumption-based
clean_text: Vertex AI Search for commerce charges $0.27 per 1,000 prediction requests for up to 20 million monthly requests, $0.18 per 1,000 for the next 280 million, and $0.10 per 1,000 above 300 million. Training and tuning cost $2.50 per node per hour. Free trial includes $600 in credits valid for 6 months. No charge for importing catalog data or user events.
